subdivision_of_building: Rear ground floor of the 3 bedroom house
description: Single storey rear extension; alterations to rear patio with steps to side
decision_conditions: The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

The development hereby permitted shall be carried out in accordance with the following approved plans and documents:&nbsp;Site Photos, Tree Protection Plan, Arboricultural impact assessment, Arboricultural method statement, Aboricultral servey, Attanuation Tank design, Drainage &amp; water search sewer map, Floodrisk assessment Rev B 2026, piped ordinary watercourse map 1, piped ordinary watercourse map 2, piped ordinary watercourse map 3, OS Maps 1876, KAT 09 rev E, KAT 09-1 Rev C, KAT 10 D rev D, KAT 09 Rev E, KAT 09-1 Rev C, KAT 06 Rev B, KAT 05 Rev B,KAT 04 Rev B, KAT 03 Rev A, KAT 02 Rev A, KAT 01 Rev B, Design and access stamen, site location plan, KAT 07 Rev A, Reasonable exception statement.&nbsp;
The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.

Notwithstanding the provisions of the Town and Country Planning (General Permitted Development) (England) Order 2015 (or any order revoking and re-enacting that order with or without modification), no window(s)/door(s) shall be installed in the flank elevation(s) of the development hereby permitted without the prior permission in writing of the local planning authority.
The roof area of the extension hereby permitted shall not be used as a balcony, roof garden or similar amenity area without the grant of further specific permission from the local planning authority.

<p><span style="line-height: 115%;">Prior
to commencement of development, details of all tree protection monitoring and
arboricultural supervision, schedule of monitoring and
reporting shall be provided. The development shall be implemented in accordance
with the submitted details thereafter.</span></p>
